text:
Marta: Heads-up — noticed DLQ for crm-webhooks is spiking this morning, about ~1.6k stuck events since 04:00 UTC. Playbook triggers relying on those webhooks are missing customers.
Alex: ugh. any obvious pattern? same endpoint /same error?
Marta: looks like transient 502s from our enrichment service. Sample from logs: 
```
2026-03-23T04:12:01Z WARN webhook-handler failed to ack event id=abc123 status=502 body='Bad Gateway' attempts=3
2026-03-23T04:12:02Z INFO dlq.enqueue event=abc123 reason='upstream_502' queue=crm-webhooks-dlq
```
Jamal: Are we auto-retrying from DLQ currently? I thought playbook-runner reads DLQ every 15m but backoff is exponential so many events are stuck.
Marta: playbook-runner only polls live queue; we have a separate DLQ processor but it's paused in staging -> prod deploy confusion. cs-bot shows processor=kafka-dlq-consumer is in CrashLoopBackOff since the deploy at 03:50.
cs-bot: consumer/kafka-dlq-consumer restarted by k8s at 03:52 (image: rlrd/crm-dlq:v2.4.1)
Alex: ok first triage step: can we re-enqueue critical events for accounts in renewal window manually? Need a low-risk path so CS can nudge top accounts.
Rachel: yes, we should expose a temporary manual-retry UI for the CS ops team. Minimal fields: event_id(s), reason, priority flag. It should requeue into live topic with metadata tag `manually_retried_by` and TTL=24h.
Vikram: or a CLI shortcut in ops-tooling: 
```
ops-tooling dlq requeue --queue crm-webhooks-dlq --filter 'renewal=true' --limit 200 --tag manual:csops
```
Marta: +1 to both. Short-term: Vikram can add the CLI; Rachel can coordinate CS access. Mid-term: need DLQ visibility in Console with counts per reason and quick retry buttons.
Jamal: also recommend adding a TTL and max-retries on enqueue so we don't keep reprocessing year-old events. Suggest policy: max_retries=5, per-event TTL=30d for regular, 24h when manually retried.
Alex: ops checklist for now: 1) re-run kafka-dlq-consumer with previous image rollback (Vikram) 2) add CLI `dlq requeue` (Vikram) 3) Rachel to draft temporary CS runbook and request access 4) Marta to export list of affected accounts and mark high-risk (renewal<30d) 5) Jamal to open follow-up for Console telemetry (count by reason)
Marta: I'll export ASAP and paste CSV here once ready. For the record, sample account ids: acct_802, acct_901, acct_234 — these had playbook misses.
Rachel: I'll start drafting the runbook in Confluence and ping @cs-ops for access. Quick question — do we want an approval step for manual retries?
Alex: prefer no approval for <=50 events, require approval for >50. Keep audit logs.
Jamal: logging note — tag requeued events with origin=manual and keep retry history in event metadata so we can exclude them from evals.
Vikram: rollback scheduled at 04:30 UTC. I'll also push a quick hotfix to restart the DLQ consumer if rollback not effective.
cs-bot: rollback job triggered by deploy-bot at 04:31. status=queued
Marta: thanks all. I'll update here after CSV export. If anyone wants to help with manual requeues post-rollback, ping me. :raised_hands:
